tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lcags sdong ma'i rgyun khyer dge/ oṃ swasti/ bdag dang khams gsum sems can rnams/ /log pa'i lam las log nas kyang / /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /nyon mongs dbang gyur sdug bsngal las/ /thar bar bya phyir sems bskyed do/ /lan gsum/ dang po stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /lcags kyi padma 'dab brgyad gdan/ /de steng bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /sku mdog dmar po skyil krung bzhugs/ /sprul pa'i cha byad dar gos mnabs/ /phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin/ /sku che yan lag rags pa'i tshad/ /phrag pa g.yas g.yon nyi zla 'char/ /dwangs ma 'od lnga'i rgyab yol can/ /khog pa'i nang nas bag chags kyi/ /snyigs ma gdos bcas thams cad sbyangs/ /'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsis gang / /rwa ga dmar po'i mdog ltar gsal/ /spyi bo'i gtsug nas gsang gnas bar/ /lcags kyi srog rtsa smyug sdong tsam/ /ka ba btsugs pa lta bur bsam/ /nang na stong pa 'od gsal mdangs/ /kha dog lngar gsal 'od zer 'bar/ /srog rtsa'i phyi nang sngags kyi 'bru/ /dung mdog zil chags lta bur bsam/ /bde ba can nas ye shes sems/ /rang 'dra spyan drangs mkha' la bzhugs/ /bum pa'i nang nas tshe bcud lud/ /bdag gi tshangs bug nang du babs/ /dbang bskur lha dang gnyis med gyur/ /lha dang srog rtsa'i bdud rtsi las/ /'od 'phros gsal tshegs mdangs dang ldan/ /tho rengs sngags 'di brgya rtsa bzlas/ /zhes brjod la phreng ba bzung ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ na mo bha ga wa te a pa ri mi tā ā yurdzñā na su bi nishtsi ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya arha te samyaksaṃ buddha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ sarba saṃskā ra pa ri shuddha dharma te ga ga na sa murga te swa bha ba bi shuddhe ma hā na ya/ pa ri bā re swāhā/ nṛ bhrūm̐ badzra ā yu ṣe ā yurdzñā na siddhi āḥbhrūm̐/ zhes bzlas pa phreng 'khor sogs ci rigs kyi rjes su/ ting 'dzin sngags kyi 'od zer ni/ /lcags kyu lta bus snod bcud gang /

/sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /thugs rje'i byin rlabs dngos grub bsdus/ /phyogs skyong mkha' 'gro sde brgyad kyi/ /rdzu 'phrul tshe bkrag gzi mdangs phrogs/ /ri rab gling bzhi gling phran sogs/ /gser gyi ri bdun rol mtsho dang / /rtsi shing nags tshal ratna'i tshogs/ /'byung ba lnga yi dwangs ma bsdus/ /lha klu mi yi dbang thang dang / /bsod nams mi yi dngos grub bsdus/ /bdud rtsi'i 'od zer char ltar babs/ /thams cad ma lus bdag la bstim/ /bdag lus bdud rtsis gang bar bsam/ /stong gsal 'od kyi phung por gyur/ /nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i ye shes sems dpa' rang la thim/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /tshe dpag med mgon 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /tshe dpag med mgon khyed sku ci 'dra dang / /'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams sogs/ /khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag kyang 'gyur bar shog /khyed la mchod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /bdag sogs gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /nad dang dbul phongs 'thab rtsod zhi ba dang / /chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ /lo brgya 'tsho zhing ston brgya mthong ba dang / /tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /theg pa mchog la nges par 'byung ba yis/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /ces 'di sa rgan kun blo la/ /lcang can gung zhes ma ṇi dang / /lakṣ+mi'i mtshan gyis 'di ltar du/ /dgos zhes bzhed bskong don du sbyar/ ༈ /dpal ldan rdo rje rab brtan mar gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod pas dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su yi dam chos skyong gi rten mchod legs par bshams/ khyad par 'di'i gtor ma stod cha zur gsum/ smad sum gnyis zlum po thod can/ de'i g.yas zur du bshos bu zlum po thod can g.yon du gtor ma zur gsum pa mthar mtheb skyus bskor ba/

sha dmar smug rtsi mar tshon la sogs pas brgyan pa bzhag gzhan yang sman phud rakta yang bshams la/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal dag dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing / /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /oṃ shu n+yā ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng / /rang sems rdo rje hūm̐ spros las/ /'od 'phros mchod dang 'gro don byas/ /tshur 'dus yongs gyur rang nyid ni/ /khro rgyal 'byung 'dul phyag bzhi pa/ /g.yas dang rdo rje gnyis pas zhags/ /mtha' gnyis rtsa phyag g.yas bskums zhing / /g.yon brkyangs spyan gsum zhal gcig gdangs/ /smar smin skra ser gyen du brdzes/ /thod skam thod dang thod rlon zhags/ /rin chen sbrul rgyan dar sngon stod/ /stag sham can gyur zhabs 'og tu/ /'byung po dkar po mig gsum pa/ /lag bzhi g.yas na ḍā ma ru/ /gri gug g.yon na thod pa dang / /rtse gsum 'dzin cing skra ser thod/ /stag sham kha phub mnan steng na/ /ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /khro rgyal dpral mgrin thugs ka ru/ /rdo rje gsum dngos oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ /rang 'dra'i ye shes spyan drangs thim/ /dbang bskur spyan drangs dbang bskur bas/ /mi bskyod rgyas btab thugs ka yi/ /sa bon sngags bskor 'od zer gyis/ /las bzhi'i phrin las sgrub par gyur/ /hūm̐ badzra phaṭa/ ci rigs bzlas mthar/ bcom ldan khro rgyal 'byung 'dul gyis/ /bdag gi nyes tshogs kun zhi nas/ /legs yon ma lus rgyas pa sogs/ /thun mong mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /sman gtor rakta stong par gyur/ /stong pa'i ngang las rlung me'i steng / /tshad ldan thod pa sha lnga dang /

/bdud rtsi ye shes lnga 'dres las/ /sman gtor gnyis gyur rakta yang / /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag rgyun gyur/ /rang mdun trag las khrag mtsho'i dbus/ /kaṃ kaṃ yongs gyur lha mo'i sku/ /rdo rje rab brtan smug nag che/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ /g.yas na ral gri g.yon thod khrag /mchan khung ne le'i rkyal pa 'dzin/ /mi lpags stod g.yogs re lde'i sham/ /bong bu'i chibs can g.yas g.yon du/ /ming po klu can thod dkar dang / /las mkhan klu bdud nag po gnas/ /phyogs bzhir dkar sngo dmar ser gyi/ /ma mo'i tshogs dang mtha' skor du/ /chu srin ba lang dred sna ma/ /khri gnyen seng stag dur bya sogs/ /sprul pa yang sprul bsam mi khyab/ /lha mo rnams ni g.yas ral gri/ /g.yon na thod bsnams mchan khung na/ /ne le'i rkyal 'dzin dpral mgrin snying / oṃ āḥhūm̐ mtshan hūm̐ steng du/ /bhyoḥyig smug nag 'od zer gyis/ /rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi cha/ /byang shar gnas nas spyan drangs bstim/ /bhyoḥrakmo du ra dun ti bhyoḥ /kha kha du ra dun ti bhyoḥ /he la du ra dun ti bhyoḥ /re ma tī sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥpadma ka ma la yasatwaṃ/ arghaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ ba lingta khā hi/ yo gi nī khā hi/ ḍā ki nī khā hi/ stāmbha wagga ta/ a ka sa lo ho/ re ma tī sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ urga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇe daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ ma hā māṃ sa khā hi/ ma hā tsitta khā hi/ ma hā rakta khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ re ma tī sa pa ri ba ra arghaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapta āḥhūm̐/

bhyoḥ lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma/ /sku mdog smug nag chen mo la/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ /sku la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol/ /phyag g.yas ral gri 'bar ba bsnams/ /g.yon pa'i phyag gis ne'u le 'dzin/ /chibs su dre'u rta rkang gsum chibs/ /phrin las bcol ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /mtshan gsum glog ltar 'khyug cing byon/ /nyin gsum khra ltar myur zhing byon/ /ma gcig rdo rje rab brtan ma/ /dgra bo 'dul ba'i dus la babs/ /dpal ldan rdo rje rab brtan ma/ /rakta'i mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /bstan pa'i gtso mo rab brtan ma/ /khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /bstan pa gnyen po khyod kyis srungs/ /ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /rten yod na/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag 'bul na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /rten med na/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul la gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /khro rgyal dpral mgrin thugs ka ru/ /rdo rje gsum dngos oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'byung po 'dul byed 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang / /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang / /mthun pa 'grub cing phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /ces 'di sa skya kun blo la/ /lcang can gung dang nor bu'i mtshan/ /'dzin de 'di ltar gyis gsung bzhin/ /la mo gad ka na gar bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/
